sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-29 and 2016-12-29, card C11923-K2 belonging to customer C11923 was subject to unauthorized transactions totaling $131.30 USD. The activity was categorized under pattern 'card_not_present_new_device', conducted via online channel. Cardholder verification confirmed that the cardholder did not authorize the transactions and remained in possession of the card. Investigation of the associated infrastructure identified device profile 'SM-G610F Build/NRD90M |  | chrome 66.0 for android | ', which is linked to 3 other cardholder accounts (C05595-K1, C05678-K1, C03938-K1), indicating a coordinated compromise. In accordance with Bank Fraud Policy Rule R2, a Suspicious Activity Report is filed. Card C11923-K2 has been blocked and connected accounts placed under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Customer verification settled the verdict; evidence sufficient under policy stopping criteria.
